about_the_game:
Embark on a surreal journey in Your World, a VR survival game that blends open-world exploration with a dreamlike, low-poly aesthetic. Immerse yourself in a vibrant landscape where every element is crafted to inspire creativity and survival.

Experience survival like never before with VR gameplay that places you at the heart of a stylized, enchanting world. Every action, from crafting to farming, is designed to be intuitive and immersive.

With the core theme of Your World, shape the environment to your vision. Build unique structures, design intricate landscapes, and create a world that reflects your imagination.

Key Features:

  • Gather and Craft – Collect resources from the environment to craft essential tools and structures. Chop trees, mine stones, and forge metal components to build and expand your personal sanctuary.

  • Farming and Cultivation – Plant and nurture a variety of crops, designing and managing your own farm. Protect your plants from pests and ensure a thriving ecosystem.

  • Build Your Home – Construct your own shelter, from a simple hut to a sprawling homestead. Design every detail to make it truly yours, crafting furniture, decorations, and functional spaces for survival.

  • Forge and Shape – Unearth rich veins of ore hidden in the earth, then fire up smelters to turn raw metal into something more. Mold glowing ingots into vital components for tools and advanced creations, steadily unlocking the path to new technology and deeper self-sufficiency.

Keep calm and enjoy the relaxing gameplay.

In Your World, the only limit is your creativity. Prepare to build, survive, and thrive in a realm where your imagination shapes the adventure.
